patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — commercetools and Lightspeed Retail share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose commercetools only if your buying job matches “Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sale” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than commercetools's shape. Workflow advantage: commercetools leans wholesale-b2b; Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — commercetools and Lightspeed Retail share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: commercetools is Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sales. Shopify keeps the SaaS award.; Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe.
- Company-size focus: commercetools (mid-market, enterprise) vs Lightspeed Retail (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: commercetools-leaning wholesale-b2b vs Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: commercetools — No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path.

Limitations — commercetools: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Requires front-end / MACH assembly — not a weekend theme launch; Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live.

Poor-fit cases: commercetools is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet · Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · Avoid commercetools if you actually need Lightspeed Retail's motion (Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
